title: Norwegian Herbal Bread
description: A heartwarming herbal bread recipe with a touch of Norwegian flair, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add herbs and mix until well combined.
Gradually add in olive oil and water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape into a round or oblong loaf.
Place loaf on a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
